correctness.rationale: The repaired claim is only that the directed flag complex is a normal 3-pseudomanifold with exactly its eleven vertices as singularities and a Klein bottle at each vertex link. Exhaustive source-deletion applies to sizes 1–5, and absence of a transitive 5-set excludes all larger faces. The exact incidence check gives purity, exactly two tetrahedra per triangle and connected tetrahedron adjacency. It reconstructs the entire link at zero, including all lower faces, with counts (10,30,20), two triangles per edge, connected triangle adjacency and a single six-cycle at each link vertex. Thus it is a connected closed surface with Euler characteristic zero. On the closed dual walk 268–267–257–157–178–189–689–268 the orientation constraints have five negative products, so no consistent orientation exists. This identifies the surface as the Klein bottle. Translation transfers the certificate to each vertex. Edge links are circles, triangle links are pairs of points, and the tetrahedra have interior manifold charts. All required links for normality are connected, and each vertex has nonzero degree-two rational local homology from its Klein-bottle link, excluding even a manifold-with-boundary neighborhood. The corrected checker was written anew and run with Python 3, returning PALEY11_KLEIN_BOTTLE_LINKS_OK. This verifies the decisive finite inputs in the revised proof, without running any uploaded code.
residual_risks: The checker verifies the finite incidence and sign certificate, not the theorem of classification of closed surfaces. Translation is the explicit argument for all eleven links in the repaired proof.
The repaired claim does not extend to any other tournament order or to a different complex built from the same tournament.

value.rationale: The repaired result supplies local PL geometry of an established small, highly symmetric tournament complex. It determines exactly where the complex fails to be a manifold and identifies every link surface, information not determined by the known global homotopy type or homology and useful when studying strata or local homology of the complex. The concrete orientation obstruction supplies an explanation of the nonorientable link, not just an additional face count.
residual_risks: Value is limited to this natural finite complex; no new general theorem about tournaments, affine representation or quotient topology is credited.
